name: Reese’s Peanut Butter Pie
subtitle: From Lara
notes: This decadent dessert has graced a couple of Thanksgivings and has been a crowd favorite every time. Thanks Lara for sharing!

ingredients.group: Oreo pie crust (find a recipe online)

steps.title: Make the crust
steps.body: Blitz Oreos in a food processor to make **2 cups Oreo crumbs**, and add **4 Tbsp butter**, melted.

steps.title: Press the crust
steps.body: Pour mixture into a pie pan and press into an even layer on the bottom and sides. Bake at 350°F for 8-10 minutes.

steps.title: Make the ganache
steps.body: Microwave **4 oz milk chocolate chips** and **½ cup heavy whipping cream** for 30 seconds at a time and stir in between until the mixture is smooth.

steps.title: Chill the ganache
steps.body: Pour into the baked and cooled pie crust and refrigerate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add peanut butter cups
steps.body: When the ganache has cooled, cover with **9 full-size peanut butter cups**.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.body: While ganache is cooling, combine **2 Tbsp sugar** with **½ tsp vanilla** and **1 cup heavy cream** and beat until soft peaks form.

steps.title: Add peanut butter and cream cheese
steps.body: Beat in **1 cup creamy peanut butter** and then **8 oz cream cheese (room temperature)**, and finally the **½ cup sugar**.

steps.title: Spread the filling
steps.body: Add the peanut butter filling over the peanut butter cup layer.

steps.title: Drizzle (optional)
steps.body: Melt **¼ cup milk chocolate chips** and drizzle over pie to decorate.

steps.title: Whipped cream (optional)
steps.body: Whisk **1 cup heavy cream** and **2 Tbsp sugar** until stiff peaks form. Then add **2 Tbsp cocoa powder** and **½ cup powdered sugar** until combined. Pipe the cream onto the pie for extra-fancy decoration.
